summary: Tested deferred-shipping-accounts feature end-to-end. 13 new pytest cases all pass (settings is_deferred round-trip, accounts list + totals, POST payment with validation, GET payments DESC + Arabic URL-encoding, DELETE payment + 404, user isolation, Excel upload integration with deferred_shipping_cost & shipping_breakdown.is_deferred, /api/dashboard new fields). Snapchat regression suite also passes (19/19) and original backend suite (23/23) — total 55/55 backend tests green. Frontend Playwright smoke verifies register → Sidebar nav-shipping-accounts → Settings checkbox shipping-deferred-{i} → /shipping-accounts page → KPIs (totals-owed/paid/remaining) → add payment modal → payments log + delete-payment.

issues: When a user registers a payment for a deferred company BEFORE any analysis is uploaded, total_owed=0 yet total_paid increments and 'المتبقي' becomes negative (e.g., -25.00). Negative remaining may mislead users. Consider either blocking payment if total_owed==0 or clamping/labeling negatives as 'رصيد دائن'.

action_items: (Low) Consider validation/UI label so MTBAQI (remaining) cannot show a misleading negative when no analysis exists yet.
critical_code_review_comments: shipping_accounts.py date validation correctly rejects YYYY-DD-MM and non-positive amounts via Pydantic + 400 on bad date.
User isolation enforced via user_id filter on every query — verified in tests.
GET /shipping-accounts merges configured deferred companies (from settings) with aggregated owed amounts from analyses[*].shipping_breakdown — works even when no analysis yet (empty totals).
Dashboard math expected_salla_transfer = total_sales - total_payment_fees - regular_shipping_cost verified to match within 0.01 precision.

Frontend ShippingAccounts.jsx uses Arabic company names directly in data-testid (e.g., account-سمسا, toggle-payments-سمسا). Works fine in Playwright via Unicode selectors; just be aware tools that strip non-ASCII could fail.
test_credentials: admin@hesab.app / admin123 (existing). New ephemeral users created via /api/auth/register for isolation tests.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py generates /tmp/salla_test.xlsx fixture (10 Salla-format orders across سمسا/أرامكس/جندل) on demand.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest entrypoint: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v. All shipping-accounts logic green. Frontend smoke flow tested via Playwright; full e2e with real Excel upload via UI not re-tested (covered by backend Excel integration test). For UI regression, login as admin@hesab.app/admin123 and exercise: Settings → toggle shipping-deferred-0 (سمسا) → save → Sidebar nav-shipping-accounts → KPI cards → دفعة modal → السجل toggle → delete-payment-{id}.
